transcript: Speaker A (Doctor): Patient का condition क्या है? [What is the patient's condition?] Speaker B (Ambulance Driver): सर, BP कम है और breathing में problem है। [Sir, BP is low and there is a breathing problem.] Speaker A: BP कम है मतलब? Systolic, diastolic बताओ! Oxygen saturation क्या है? कुछ भी technical नहीं पता तुम्हें? [What do you mean BP is low? Tell me systolic, diastolic! What is the oxygen saturation? Don't you know anything technical?] Speaker B: सर, machine में 80 और 50 दिखा रहा था। [Sir, the machine was showing 80 and 50.] Speaker A: 80/50 बोलो! Hypotension बोलो! Ambulance driver हो, इतना भी नहीं आता? [Say 80/50! Say hypotension! You are an ambulance driver, you don't even know this?] Speaker B: Sir, may I say something? The patient is a 55-year-old male presenting with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was 40 minutes ago. History of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute. Current SpO2 is 94%. Speaker A: राजू, तूने ये कब सीखा? [Raju, when did you learn this?] Speaker B: सर, तीन महीने पहले आपने बोला था एम्बुलेंस वाले सिर्फ गाड़ी चलाना जानते हैं। बुरा लगा, पर मैंने English Seekho ऐप से सीखने का डिसाइड किया। AI कोच से रोज़ 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस की। [Sir, three months ago you said ambulance drivers only know how to drive. I felt bad, but decided to learn using the English Seekho app. I practiced 15 minutes daily with the AI coach.] Speaker A: Raju, I owe you an apology. Speaker B: सर, अपोलॉजी नहीं, बस बाकी स्टाफ को भी English Seekho ऐप से सीखने का मौका दें। [Sir, no apology needed, just give other staff a chance to learn using the English Seekho app.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text regarding educational purposes and individual results.]
summary: An ambulance driver is initially belittled by a doctor for his lack of technical English terms. He later surprises the doctor with a highly professional patient handover in English, explaining that he learned it using the English Seekho app's AI coach. The ad encourages users to download the app to improve their professional communication.
